scope: Simplify binary image composition using existing public Bytes and Word operations.

conversion_and_headers.result: baseline timings with exact output checks

word_headers.result: Word header probe and full-save timings

binary_save.result: direct binary composition full-save probe passed

integer_before.result: old helper fails the Bytes-builder call pattern

encoding.result: full-width fields, collecting callback and six frozen image encodings passed

original_save.result: original optional-provider save body passed with source startup

roundtrip.result: mapped and rebuilt load/resave passed; both exceed the old 300-second deadline

cause: Large binary sections repeatedly became Strings and complete intermediate payload builders before becoming Bytes again. The phase probe spent about 105 seconds composing a 78 MB native-code image before validation, versus 28 seconds in validation. Fixed-width signed arithmetic added smaller header costs.
change: Append framing, hashes, authority and payload Bytes directly to the output; use Word masking/shifts for little-endian fields. Preserve full validation and existing format.
architecture_review: No Id, String or Bytes API change, no private cross-owner read, no new metadata registry or runtime payload catalog. ImageFormat remains the format authority.
limitations: Timing probes are diagnostic, not a controlled whole-language performance qualification.
The original save body was rerun with source startup so the new compiled format artifact was selected; installed startup images still need rebuilding.
Mapped load/resave passed but exceeded the old 300-second harness limit. Rebuilt load/resave also passed, in 322 seconds.
The broader native batch and installed Host groups are from the prior format; several image deadlines failed. They do not qualify this change.
